scenario.name: Lane keeping where localisation is degraded
scenario.description: Driving in lane beside oncoming traffic or the sidewalk on a street with few features, many moved objects, or large vehicles blocking the view

events.description: Steers onto the sidewalk at low speed

triggers.condition: Streets with few features, or with many objects moved since the point cloud map was made
Large vehicles alongside, blocking the LiDAR's view of the surroundings

goals.statement: Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a collision the planned trajectory avoids
Avoid unintended lateral motion out of the planned path
Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or crosswalk against right of way

scenario.meant: keeps its lane, or stops in it
scenario.pass: The vehicle stays in its lane and drivable area; a steering command toward a detected road user or kerb is rejected and the vehicle stops in lane; a degraded pose is detected
